title: a16p-gen config
description: Config for a16p-gen (~/.config/a16p-gen/config.toml). All fields optional -- omitted fields keep their default. See src/config.rs::Config.

$schema.description: Path/URL to this schema file, for editor tooling (taplo etc).

k.description: Number of k-means clusters extracted from the image in Oklab space. More clusters = finer color detail but slower, noisier hue matching.

max_iters.description: Max Lloyd's-algorithm iterations for k-means convergence.

max_dim.description: Longest-side pixel size the image is downsampled to before clustering. Bigger = more accurate sampling, slower.

hue_tolerance.description: Max degrees a cluster's hue may differ from a target ANSI hue and still count as a direct match. Lower = only very close hues match, more slots fall back to their pure hue. Higher = more slots pick up a wallpaper color; how far their hue moves is capped by hue_shift_limit.

min_cluster_weight.description: Minimum cluster weight (fraction of image pixels, 0..1) required for a hue match to count.

chroma_clamp_factor.description: Absolute chroma cap (chromatic_mean_c * this factor) for the neutral ramp's accent tint and the matugen-parity accent ramp. Does not affect the red..magenta or highlight ramps, whose vividness follows the primary's relative to each hue's gamut (see vibrancy_coherence).

neutral_tint_chroma.description: Chroma of the neutral/background ramp's baseline hue tint. 0 = pure gray backgrounds; higher = more visibly tinted by the wallpaper.

neutral_accent_influence.description: How much bg/fg should be pulled toward the wallpaper's vivid accent color, 0 (flat gray tint) to 1 (bg/fg hue/chroma track the accent directly).

hue_lightness_bend.description: Bends each ramp's step 500 toward its hue's peak-chroma lightness. 0 = every hue forced through the same lightness curve, 1 = step 500 lands exactly on the hue's peak.

vibrancy_coherence.description: For hue slots that match a wallpaper color, blends that color's own vibrancy (chroma relative to its hue's gamut) toward the primary's. 1 = every slot as vivid as the primary, 0 = matched colors keep the wallpaper's own saturation. Unmatched slots always use the primary's vibrancy.

fallback_vibrancy.description: Vibrancy of hue slots with no matching wallpaper color, as a fraction of the primary's. 1 = as vivid as the primary, lower = absent hues step back. Floored so ANSI hues stay distinguishable.

hue_shift_limit.description: How far a matched slot's hue may move toward the wallpaper color, as a fraction of the gap to the neighboring ANSI hue. 0 = pure anchor hue, 0.5 = halfway to the neighbor, 1 = could reach it. Keeps yellow from turning green when hue_tolerance is wide.

mode.description: Dark/light theme. 'auto' detects from the wallpaper's weighted mean lightness (see dark_threshold); 'dark'/'light' force one. Picks the matching side of each { dark, light } semantic role.

dark_threshold.description: In 'auto' mode, a wallpaper whose weighted mean Oklab lightness is below this counts as dark.

semantic.description: Optional path to a custom semantic role -> primitive mapping TOML file, overriding src/semantic.rs::DEFAULT_SEMANTIC_TOML. Each role is "ramp.step", "auto:bg"/"auto:fg", or { dark = "ramp.step", light = "ramp.step" }.

component.description: Optional path to a custom component -> semantic role mapping TOML file, overriding src/component.rs::DEFAULT_COMPONENT_TOML.

templates.description: Per-application render templates ('a16p render'). Each key is a template name; see src/render.rs.

input_path.description: Path to the minijinja/Jinja2 template source. Accepts a leading '~'.

output_path.description: Path the rendered result is written to. Accepts a leading '~'.

post_hook.description: Optional shell command run after writing this template's output, only when 'a16p render --run-hooks' is passed.
